title: Rift Runners
brief: An original arena game: collect salvage, build cover and ramps, and outlast bots inside a shrinking rift.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: Scrap Circuit
chapters.story: Jax enters the circuit to win safe passage for a stranded salvage crew.

chapters.title: Moving Horizon
chapters.story: The horizon is moving. Rin teaches the runners to turn scrap into routes and cover.

chapters.title: The Rift Crown
chapters.story: Aster can close the rift after the final trial proves who can bring the crew through.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
